name: CLIC
description: Segment the impacted canine on a CBCT scan, and say where it sits.

scans.description: One CBCT (.nii/.nii.gz), or a folder of them for a batch. Folders are searched recursively.

output_dir.description: Where the segmentations are written. Nothing is written outside it.

model.description: The Mask R-CNN checkpoint (.pth). Left empty, this tool uses the one installed for it, refusing rather than choosing when several are: upstream took the alphabetically first file in a folder, so which model vintage ran depended on file names.

score_threshold.description: Detections scoring below this are not painted. The one knob that moves the segmentation, so it is recorded in the report.

device.description: "cuda" or "cpu". CUDA falls back to CPU when no card is visible.
